chunks: And Jabir has narrated from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him:
That Ali, peace be upon him, used to give to the blood relatives instead of the mawali.

key_terms.أُولِي الْأَرْحَامِ: blood relatives; kin connected by family ties
key_terms.الْمَوَالِي: freed slaves or clients with affiliative ties
key_terms.يُعْطِي: he would give; here, assign or award inheritance

ai.seo_question: In inheritance, are blood relatives given priority over mawali?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Ali عليه السلام gave precedence in inheritance to blood relatives over mawali. It reflects a legal ruling concerning the order of entitlement in inheritance and highlights the priority of kinship ties in such cases.
